text: “My effort is finished and done with!” “Well, mine is not.” “We must bear things together,” said Catherine. “That’s what we ought to do.” Morris attempted a natural smile. “There are some things which we can’t very well bear together—for instance, separation.” “Why do you speak of separation?” “Ah! you don’t like it; I knew you wouldn’t!” “Where are you going, Morris?” she suddenly asked. He fixed his eye on her for a moment, and for a part of that moment she was afraid of it.
